name: retry-decorator
title: Fix a retry decorator
prompt:
The `retry` decorator in `retrying.py` misbehaves: it retries on every exception, swallows the final
error (returns None), always waits the same delay and breaks `__name__`/`__doc__`.

Required behavior of `retry(times=3, exceptions=(Exception,), base_delay=0.1, sleep=time.sleep)`:
- `times` = total number of attempts; must be an int >= 1, otherwise `ValueError` when `retry(...)`
  is called
- only exceptions listed in `exceptions` (a class or a tuple of classes) are retried; any other
  exception propagates immediately
- before attempt n+1 it calls `sleep(base_delay * 2 ** n)` (n = 0, 1, ...); no sleep after the last attempt
- when every attempt fails, the LAST exception is re-raised
- the decorated function keeps its `__name__` and `__doc__` and works on methods
